text: 84年的，8月中旬因为受不了领导的PUA裸辞。
en: Born in '84, in mid-August I handed in my notice without another job to go to, because I could no longer stomach my boss's PUA.

text: 裸辞后的第二天去医院做了乳腺结节手术！
en: The very next day after quitting, I went to hospital and had surgery for a breast nodule!

text: 因为觉得到了这个年纪身体才是最重要的。
en: Because I felt that at this age, health is what matters most.

text: 手术做完后因为暂时不想工作，在家里待着又很无聊，于是在结合自己的兴趣后，9月初在家里布置了一间工作室打算线上线下卖衣服！
en: After the operation, since I didn't want to work for the time being and found it boring just staying at home, I drew on my interests and at the start of September set up a studio at home, planning to sell clothes both online and offline!

text: 可正当我打算好好卖衣服发展副业时，上周六我老妈摔断了腿，于是我又放下手中的衣服去医院照顾老妈！
en: But just as I was about to properly sell clothes and build up a side business, last Saturday my old mum broke her leg, so I put the clothes aside and went to hospital to care for her!

text: 此刻刚刚从医院回到家，靠在床头，一种深深的无力感和迷惘感围绕着我，心里很堵！
en: Just now I got back home from hospital and leaned against the bedhead; a deep sense of helplessness and bewilderment closed in around me, and my heart felt terribly blocked!

text: 内心一种悲观情绪油然而生：父母年纪越来越大，而我到了这个年纪还在为未来迷惘！
en: A pessimistic feeling welled up inside: my parents are getting older and older, yet here I am at this age still bewildered about the future!

text: 此刻写着想着貌似又有些想通了：过得不如意的人多了去了，大家都还在拼命咬牙坚持着，我又有什么理由去悲观去焦虑呢！
en: Writing and thinking it through now, I seem to have come to terms with it a little: there are ever so many people whose lives are unsatisfactory, yet everyone is still gritting their teeth and holding on, so what right do I have to be pessimistic and anxious!

text: 心底顿时又注入了鸡血，老妈还是得去照顾，服装工作室也得坚持做下去！
en: My spirits lifted again in an instant, I still have to look after my old mum, and I must keep the clothing studio going!

text: 绝不能颓废沮丧，因为能依靠和拯救我的只有我自己！
en: I must never let myself slump into decadence or despair, because the only one I can rely on and save myself with is me!

text: 最后跟自己说一声：加油！
en: Finally, a word to myself: keep going!

text: 四十不惑。
en: At forty, free of doubts.

text: 就是大概看清楚了这个社会。
en: It's just that I've more or less seen through this society.

text: 也大概看清楚了这一生。
en: And more or less seen through this life as well.

text: 其实要五十岁才能完全看清楚。
en: In truth, it's only at fifty that one can see it all completely clearly.

text: 今年37马上38了。
en: This year I'm 37, turning 38 before long.

text: 好奇怪一眨眼到中年了。
en: How strange, in the blink of an eye I've reached middle age.

text: 26岁成婚，27岁生娃。
en: Married at 26, had a child at 27.

text: 人生计划轨迹是相夫教子。
en: My planned life trajectory was to support my husband and raise our children.

text: 做个家庭主妇。
en: To be a housewife.

text: 后面经历了家暴，出轨。
en: Later I went through domestic violence and infidelity.

text: 一度怀疑人生。
en: For a time I was driven to question life itself.

text: 挣扎了几年离婚了。
en: After struggling for a few years, I got divorced.

text: 开始创业，有个小团队，目前欧洲时间更长因为国内实在卷不下去了。
en: I started my own business, have a small team, and these days spend more time in Europe, because back home I simply couldn't carry on with the relentless grind.

text: 目前一切正常，过着平凡的生活。
en: At present everything is normal, and I live an ordinary life.

text: 有个小自己十岁的闺蜜每天厮混一起
en: I have a close friend ten years my junior, and we hang out together every day

text: 三个字：不如意！
en: Three words: unsatisfactory!

text: 真实生活困顿甚至一地鸡毛。
en: Real life is straitened, even a complete mess.

text: 家庭往往不和睦，主要是犯错成本高，打破个碟子都能吵半天。
en: Families are often far from harmonious, mainly because the cost of making a mistake is so high, smashing a plate can spark a row that lasts half the day.

text: 由于家庭容错率太低，芝麻小的事情都被放得很大。
en: Because the family's tolerance for error is far too low, even the most trivial matters get blown up out of all proportion.

text: 当矛盾和问题出现时，家里人不是想着怎么去解决，而是相互责怪。
en: When conflict or problems arise, family members don't think about how to resolve them, but instead blame one another.

text: 中年的不如意，大概率还是因为认知过低，大事没有得到有效的指导，倒是小事斤斤计较，正所谓几十块的香烟思前想后，几十万的股票一往无前。
en: The dissatisfaction of middle age is, more often than not, down to low cognition: major matters receive no effective guidance, yet one haggles over every trifle, just as the saying goes, deliberating endlessly over a cigarette worth a few tens of yuan, yet charging ahead without a second thought on stocks worth hundreds of thousands.

text: 这是家族基因的一种外显，祖祖辈辈的经历刻在基因里，形成了后代的本能。
en: This is an outward expression of the family's genes; the experiences of generation upon generation are etched into the genes, forming the instincts of those who come after.

text: 你如果细心去观察中年男人这个群体，越是底层，越爱争辩逞口舌之快、面子之争，为什么呢？
en: If you observe the group that is middle-aged men carefully, you'll find that the lower they sit in the hierarchy, the more they love to argue and savour a verbal victory, a contest of face, and why is that?

text: 因为除了口舌与自尊，他们已一无所有。
en: Because apart from their tongues and their self-esteem, they have nothing left.

text: 俗称你到底要辩个输赢，还是要赢？
en: As the common saying goes: do you want to win the argument, or do you want to win?

text: 落魄的中年男人一般都不愿意和富人在一起，因为他感觉在富人身边，富人不尊重他。
en: Down-and-out middle-aged men generally don't care to keep company with the wealthy, because they feel the rich don't respect them when they're around.

text: 这让他失去了提升认知的大好机会。
en: This robs him of a golden chance to raise his cognition.

text: 人在越穷的时候，越喜欢拿道德去绑架别人。
en: The poorer a person is, the more they like to use morality to bind and coerce others.

text: 总觉得自己是个好人，别人一身的不是。
en: They always think of themselves as a good person, while everyone else is nothing but faults.

text: 一个男人很穷的时候，不要满嘴都是“爱”，因为爱是需要转帐的。
en: When a man is very poor, he shouldn't have "love" on his lips the whole time, because love requires a bank transfer.

text: 当务之急是摆脱贫穷，这样最起码你能给父母孩子好的生活。
en: The pressing priority is to shake off poverty, so that at the very least you can give your parents and children a decent life.

text: 挣钱是很难的，80%的男人意识到社会的残酷和赚钱的艰难时，大部分已经到了30岁，当你找到点感觉，开始努力赚钱的时候，对不起，你已经40岁了。
en: Earning money is hard; by the time 80% of men come to realise the cruelty of society and how difficult it is to make money, most are already 30; and when you finally get the feel of it and start striving to earn, I'm sorry, but you're already 40.

text: 40岁是人生重要的揭榜节点，如果你还在底层徘徊，说明整个框架出了重大问题。
en: Forty is a crucial juncture at which life's report card is revealed; if you're still hovering at the bottom, it means the whole framework has a serious problem.

text: 一个很常见的毛病，做的不深不透不专。
en: A very common failing is not doing things deeply, thoroughly, or with real specialisation.

text: 好像感觉自己都懂，但没有一个深耕。
en: You get the feeling you understand it all, yet have gone deep in none of it.

text: 为何这样说？
en: Why do I say this?

text: 因为只要你肯坚持，愿意深耕，随着时间的推移，会有越来越多的对手掉队。
en: Because as long as you're willing to persist and to go deep, as time goes by more and more of your rivals will drop out.

text: 最后当你手握的筹码越来越多，而竞争对手所剩无几时，你就将有很大的机会换取到高额的回报。
en: In the end, when the chips in your hand keep growing while hardly any competitors remain, you'll stand a strong chance of trading them in for a handsome return.

text: 你们猜猜网络上40多岁的人活跃的为什么那么少？
en: Have a guess: why are there so few active people in their forties online?

text: 能升上去的，早就升上去了，升不上去的，也就这个样子了。
en: Those who could be promoted were promoted long ago; those who couldn't are simply stuck as they are.

text: 有句话叫做35岁升不到副处，终身无望。
en: There's a saying: if you haven't made deputy section chief by 35, you're without hope for life.

text: 就算没有这个锅，过几年，到40多岁，也就是职场老油条，最后还是要被干掉。
en: Even without that particular pressure, a few years on, by the time you're in your forties, you'll just be a workplace old hand, and in the end you'll still be shown the door.

text: 工资高，年龄大，家里的破事还多，公司为啥用你呢？
en: High salary, older age, and a household full of troubles, why on earth would the company keep you on?

text: 真正的人间清醒，是从入职的那一刻开始，就知道是个有限游戏，迟早要分手。
en: True clarity about the world means knowing from the very moment you join that it's a finite game, and that you'll part ways sooner or later.

text: 早就开始在业余时间弄副业，扩大交际面了。
en: They started a side business in their spare time long ago, and broadened their circle of contacts.

text: 大佬：“我最近发现一个有趣的现象，中年职场人的春天，感觉快要来了。
en: Big Shot: "I've recently noticed an interesting phenomenon, it feels as though the spring of middle-aged workers is about to arrive.

text: 我：“大佬您看玩笑呢?且不说35岁那条‘红线’摆在那，现在还有大把年轻人在找工作，尤其是今年应届生那么多。
en: Me: "Big Shot, are you joking? Not to mention that 'red line' at 35 is right there, there are still hordes of young people looking for work now, especially with so many graduates this year.

text: 我：“企业会放着便宜的年轻人不用，然后去招价格更贵，性价比更低的中年人?”
en: Me: "Would a company pass over cheap young people and instead hire middle-aged people who cost more and offer poorer value for money?"

text: 大佬：“放不软的猕猴桃便宜，你会买吗?”
en: Big Shot: "Would you buy a kiwi fruit that won't soften up even when cheap?"

text: 我：“这干嘛要买?买了又吃不了，这不是浪费钱?”
en: Me: "Why would I buy that? I couldn't eat it anyway, wouldn't that just be wasting money?"

text: 大佬：“对的，那招进来不能立刻用，多说一两句就觉得自己被PUA，动不动喊着‘整顿职场’‘躺平’的年轻人，即使便宜，但如果无法为公司解决问题。
en: Big Shot: "Exactly. Then as for young people who can't be put to use straight away, who feel PUA'd the moment you say a word or two, and who constantly shout about 'rectifying the workplace' and 'lying flat', even if cheap, if they can't solve the company's problems.

text: 大佬：“那么招进来，究竟是为企业带来效益，还是成为一种负担?换你是老板，你又会做怎样的决策?”
en: Big Shot: "So when you bring them in, are they bringing the enterprise real benefit, or becoming a burden? Put yourself in the boss's shoes, what decision would you make?"

text: 大佬：“当然我说这话，很多人估计又要开喷‘这是什么资本家言论’‘又在这搞PUA’，但说实话，一个年入几百万，上千万的老板，其实并没有空整天盯着下属那一两千块工资抠抠搜搜。
en: Big Shot: "Of course, saying this, many people will probably start blasting off again about 'what capitalist rhetoric is this' and 'more PUA', but to be honest, a boss earning a few million or tens of millions a year simply doesn't have the time to be penny-pinching over his subordinates' thousand-or-two wages all day.

text: 大佬：“说到底，上班也是以结果为导向，能产出效益，老板自然愿意给钱，如果老板不给钱，整个求职市场也是相对公开透明，打工人完全可以辞职跳槽换老板。
en: Big Shot: "At the end of the day, going to work is also results-oriented; if you can produce results, the boss will naturally be willing to pay, and if the boss won't pay, the whole job market is relatively open and transparent, so workers can simply resign, switch jobs, and change bosses.

text: 大佬：“如果能力真的非常强，也可以自己当老板，据我所知，深圳针对创业的补助资金，还是比较可观，路都是开放的，关键在于你在什么段位。
en: Big Shot: "If your ability is truly outstanding, you can become your own boss; as far as I know, Shenzhen's subsidy funds for starting a business are fairly substantial, the paths are open, the key lies in what tier you're at.

text: 我：“您这说法有一定的道理，但我有一个疑问。
en: Me: "What you say has some merit, but I have a question.

text: 我：“如果年轻人的被你说得那么不堪，那为什么过去那么多好企业会大批量招应届生，甚至应届毕业生的工资，比老员工还高?”
en: Me: "If young people are as hopeless as you make them out to be, then why did so many good companies mass-hire graduates in the past, even paying freshers more than old employees?"

text: 大佬：“公司任务以及管理者给企业补贴是一方面，此一时彼一时的大环境变化，又是另外一方面，前者没什么好说的，我们主要来谈谈后者。
en: Big Shot: "Company quotas and the subsidies managers give to enterprises are one aspect; the shifting macro-environment, which is another time and another set of circumstances, is the other, there's not much to say about the former, so let's mainly talk about the latter.

text: 大佬：“之前企业之所以喜欢应届生，说白了就是听话，学习能力强，好塑造。
en: Big Shot: "The reason companies liked graduates before boils down to this: they're obedient, quick to learn, and easy to mould.

text: 大佬：“听话自然对应着肯加班，老实执行任务，不摸鱼偷懒，这比起工作几年的‘老油条’来说，绝对是个重要优势。
en: Big Shot: "Being obedient naturally means a willingness to work overtime, to execute tasks dutifully, and not to slack or skive, which, compared with the 'old hands' of a few years' standing, is absolutely a major advantage.

text: 大佬：“但这几年随着互联网的大发展，以及老一辈的财富做后盾，‘躺平’‘反内卷’‘上班摸鱼’的风潮逐渐扎根到年轻人的内心，直接让年轻人失去了对比中年人的重要优势，也逐渐失去性价比。
en: Big Shot: "But in recent years, with the great development of the internet and the wealth of the older generation as a backstop, the trend of 'lying flat', 'anti-involution' and 'slacking off at work' has gradually taken root in young people's minds, directly stripping young people of their key advantage over the middle-aged, and gradually eroding their value for money as well.

text: 大佬：“至于学习能力强，则对应过去企业高速发展的快速扩张，对于企业涉及的新业务，已经工作了一段时间、思维相对固化的中年人自然不太适合，年轻人反而容易凭借较高的学习能力，没有定性的思维去闯出一片天。
en: Big Shot: "As for being quick to learn, that corresponded to the rapid expansion of enterprises in their high-growth phase; for new business the company was venturing into, middle-aged people who had already worked a while and had relatively rigid thinking were naturally a poor fit, whereas young people, relying on stronger learning ability and a mind not yet set in its ways, could more easily break new ground.

text: 大佬：“这样一来，中年人的工作经验自然变得不值钱，甚至由于精力不如年轻人，工资被刚入职的年轻人反超也不足为奇。
en: Big Shot: "In this way, middle-aged people's work experience naturally becomes cheap, and it's hardly surprising that, with less energy than the young, their wages get overtaken by newcomers fresh out of the gate.

text: 我：“按照您的说法就是，过去年轻人看着使用价格高，但因为精力充沛能卷，所以性价比比中年人更高，且年轻人的特性更符合企业新业务发展特性，所以更多企业倾向招应届生?”
en: Me: "So by your account, in the past young people looked expensive to employ, but because they were energetic and could grind, their value for money was higher than the middle-aged, and young people's traits better matched the needs of enterprises' new business, so more companies inclined to hire graduates?"

text: 大佬：“没错，但现在情况完全变了，大厂、大公司都在收缩业务，砍掉各类创新但不赚钱的板块，那么这时候的企业更需要能立刻上手，经验充足的中年人。
en: Big Shot: "Precisely, but the situation has changed completely now: big factories and big companies are all contracting their operations and cutting various innovative but unprofitable divisions, so at this point enterprises need middle-aged people who can hit the ground running and have ample experience.

text: 大佬：“所以你会看到，大公司发展时最喜欢招年轻人，收缩裁员时也是年轻人最先遭殃，除了赔偿少外，年轻人无法匹配企业发展阶段也是重要的一点。
en: Big Shot: "So you'll see that big companies most love hiring young people when expanding, and it's also young people who are hit first when retrenching and laying off, apart from lower severance, the fact that young people can't match the company's stage of development is also a key point.

text: 大佬：“更何况前三年不少大学生只能上网课，难以走出校园，社会接触太少，进一步削弱了大学生的能力，思想上更为简单且不成熟，加速降低了年轻人与企业业务间的匹配程度。
en: Big Shot: "What's more, in the past three years many university students could only take online classes and found it hard to step off campus, with too little contact with society, further weakening their abilities, making them mentally simpler and more immature, and accelerating the drop in how well young people match corporate needs.

text: 大佬：“也正因如此，我才说职场中年人的春天来了，哪怕不做管理层，只是做一个经验丰富的大头兵，只要在一个公司待得够久，业务比较核心，那么暂时的安稳还是能够保证。
en: Big Shot: "And it's precisely because of this that I say the spring of middle-aged workers has come; even without being in management, just as an experienced rank-and-file worker, as long as you stay long enough at one company and your work is fairly core, a temporary stability can still be guaranteed.

text: 大佬：“未来即使中年人选择跳槽，结果大概率也会比没有什么经验的年轻人更有优势，更关键一点在于，中年人上有老下有小，身上还有房贷，虽然精力上较年轻人差点，但听话能卷的动。
en: Big Shot: "Even if middle-aged people choose to switch jobs in future, the outcome will most likely favour them over inexperienced young people; the more crucial point is that the middle-aged have elders above and children below, and a mortgage on their backs, though a bit short on energy compared with the young, they're obedient and can still grind.

text: 我：“虽然您分析的有道理，但是上学卷，毕业后还要卷，真的好累，人生短暂，不想一辈子都这么累。
en: Me: "Although your analysis makes sense, it's gruelling studying hard, then grinding again after graduating, it's truly exhausting, life is short, and I don't want to be weary all my life.

text: 大佬：“生存，从来都不是件容易的事，大环境好的时候大家都轻松，大环境不好的时候僧多粥少，要卷着生存还是不想自己太累，就看自己怎么选。
en: Big Shot: "Survival has never been easy; when the macro-environment is good everyone relaxes, but when it's bad there's more porridge than ladles, and whether to grind to survive or not to tire yourself too much comes down to your own choice.

text: 大佬：“至于网上所谓的‘躺平’‘别卷’‘整顿职场’等言论，听听笑笑就好，如果当真且贯彻执行，最后会发现‘小丑竟是我自己’，对手渔翁得利，中年人躺着获利。
en: Big Shot: "As for the so-called online talk of 'lying flat', 'stop grinding', 'rectifying the workplace' and the like, just listen and laugh it off; if you take it seriously and act on it, you'll end up finding 'the clown turns out to be me', with rivals reaping the spoils while the middle-aged profit lying down.

text: 我：“唉，那大佬您有什么靠谱的建议呢?”
en: Me: "Sigh, so Big Shot, what sensible advice do you have?"

text: 大佬：“首先得对自己所掌握的技能，进行一个基本评估，究竟是负资产技能，还是正资产技能。
en: Big Shot: "First, you must make a basic assessment of the skills you possess, are they negative-asset skills or positive-asset skills?

text: 我：“这两个概念我倒是第一次听说，是什么意思?”
en: Me: "These two concepts I'm hearing for the first time, what do they mean?"

text: 大佬：“简单点来说，就是以无门槛纯体力劳动为线，如果你做专业工作的工资低于这条线，那么你的技能价值为负数，反之为正。
en: Big Shot: "Simply put, draw a line at unskilled pure manual labour; if the wage for your professional work falls below this line, then the value of your skill is negative, and vice versa positive.

text: 大佬：“举个简单的例子，如果当地摇奶茶的月薪为5千，而你作为财会专业的应届生去干财务，大部分公司给你开的工资才4千，那么说明你这个技能点为负1千，而这1千算是‘支付’给企业的培养费用。
en: Big Shot: "A simple example: if the local monthly wage for shaking milk tea is 5,000, and you, a fresh finance graduate, go to do accounting, but most companies only offer you 4,000, then your skill point is negative by 1,000, and that 1,000 counts as the 'tuition' paid to the company for training you.

text: 大佬：“之所以提这个点，是在于提醒年轻人明白自己技能水平在哪，换种心态去看待自己与公司间的关系，如果你认为公司给予的‘培训’不值，那么选择不接受也没关系。
en: Big Shot: "The reason for raising this point is to remind young people where their skill level actually stands, and to view their relationship with the company in a different frame of mind; if you feel the 'training' the company gives isn't worth it, then it's perfectly fine to choose not to accept it.

text: 大佬：“其实真的没必要抱怨工资低，只能说这家‘公司学校’教育质量不行，摆正心态，双向互选，不怕工资低，就怕待着技能点没法提升。
en: Big Shot: "Honestly there's no need to complain about low pay; you can only say this 'company school's' educational quality is poor, set your attitude right, it's a two-way mutual choice, don't fear low pay, fear instead staying put with no way to raise your skill points.

text: 我：“读书几载，学到的东西不仅不值钱，价值还是负?”
en: Me: "After studying for years, what I've learned is not only worthless, but negatively valued?"

text: 大佬：“对普通求生存的人而言，无法运用于实践的理论，不是包袱是什么?任何理论，只有落地才有价值，而从理论到落地的这个阶段，必然是要付学费的。
en: Big Shot: "For an ordinary person just trying to get by, theory that can't be put into practice, what is it if not baggage? Any theory only has value once it lands; and the stage from theory to landing inevitably requires paying tuition.

text: 大佬：“其次，工作挣钱只需要为钱的源头负责，如果你是业务岗，那么就服务好你的客户，做好你的业务;如果你是文员岗，那就只对掌握你升职加薪的领导负责。
en: Big Shot: "Second, working and earning only requires being accountable to the source of the money: if you're in a business role, then serve your clients well and do your business; if you're in a clerical role, then be accountable only to the leader who controls your promotion and pay rise.

text: 大佬：“生存方式不同而已，没有高下之分，做PPT画饼是一种，讨好领导也是一种，默默干活为公司解决难点也是一种，领导没那么傻，每个人有什么用心里很清楚，不至于把真能干活的全部干掉。
en: Big Shot: "It's just a different way of surviving, with no hierarchy of worth, making PPTs and painting rosy pictures is one, currying favour with leaders is another, quietly getting on with the work and solving the company's hard problems is yet another; leaders aren't that foolish, they know perfectly well who's useful, and won't go so far as to get rid of everyone who can actually deliver.

text: 大佬：“当然如果他真是这种笨领导，赶紧远离，因为他离自己被干掉也就不远，找准自己的定位，做好属于自己的角色，别傻乎乎的朝着一个方向卷。
en: Big Shot: "Of course, if he really is that dim a leader, get away fast, because he's not far from being shown the door himself; find your own positioning, play the role that's yours, and don't foolishly grind away in a single direction.

text: 我：“还有么?”
en: Me: "Anything else?"

text: 大佬：“最后也是最重要..........
en: Big Shot: "Last, and most important..........
